summary: Build practical seed systems and input distribution management skills in 5 days. Learn planning, traceability, and distribution control.
lede: Seed systems and input distribution management covers how seed operations and supply-chain professionals plan and track seed from production to delivery. Participants practice assessing supply gaps, planning routes and replenishment, monitoring storage and lot traceability, reconciling stock, and reporting distribution performance. Exercises use seed balance sheets, distribution plans, inventory checklists, and channel scorecards to support quality checks and oversight across formal and decentralized channels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage seed movement, quality control, and distribution performance across formal and decentralized channels.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software and be prepared to work with sample seed stock, dispatch, and quality records. Familiarity with seed terminology, basic logistics concepts, and Excel functions such as sorting, filtering, and simple formulas is recommended.
